title: Declared calculation prop field `taken_branch` is never read by CalculationHero
description: The local CalculationHeroProps.calculation interface declares `taken_branch?: string | null` (line 41), but the component only ever consumes `taken_branch_index` (line 460). `taken_branch` is read nowhere in CalculationHero.tsx. It mirrors the wider trace wire type (types/trace.ts), but on THIS component's prop surface it is dead: it can be removed from the local interface without affecting behaviour, narrowing the component's declared contract to what it actually uses. Low value; flagged for completeness.
evidence: Grep for `taken_branch\b` in frontend/src shows it consumed only in types/guards.ts and types/trace.ts (parsing) and asserted in guard/TracePanel tests; within CalculationHero.tsx the only branch-index read is line 460 `calculation.taken_branch_index ?? takenBranchIndex`. No reference to `calculation.taken_branch` exists in the component.
behavior_preservation: Field is never read in this component; removing it from the local prop interface changes no runtime behaviour and only tightens the declared type to the fields actually used.
